item.tib: stod 'dul rgyud kyi bsgrags pa/ bar gsang rgyud kyi bsgrags pa/ smad drag rtsub kyi chos rgyud kyi bsgrags pa
item.coloph: stod 'dul rgyud ci ltar 'byung ba'i bsgrags pa/ bar sngags rgyud ci ltar 'byung ba'i bsgrags pa/ smad chos rgyud drag rtsub gyi (kyi) bskal pa ji ltar byung ba'i bsgrags pa dang gsum/ mu spungs gsal ba bdag gis yi ger bris/ bla chen gyis phyi rabs don du phyag sbal du sbas nas/ gsang bar sbas so/ dral pa khri srung sde (srong lde) btsan gyis/ g.yung drung bon bsnub pa'i dus su/ g.yung drung bon rgyud ma bu bcas pa/ bsgrags pa skor gsum/ rten dbu thod gcig sku sha dang bcas pa/ sham po'i dal la gter du sbas/ rul dang zag pa mi 'gyur gsung (gsungs) / g+hi wang gur gum rgya yis btab/ rgya gsum gyis rgya yis btab ste/ phyi rgya ri brag mtsho yis btab/ nang rgya gur gum spos kyis btab/ gsang rgya dregs pa gsum gyis btab nas/ sbas pa lags so/ 'phel zad smon lam dkar nag btab/ nga yi bka' sde 'di rnams kyang / dam med ru tra'i lag tu ma shor bar/ dam can srung ma rnams kyis bya ra gyis/ 'phel ba'i smon lam ni/ bka' sde 'di rnams kyang / dus la babs pa'i tshe/ spang la me tog brdol ba bzhin/ rgyal ba'i rgyad 'dzin bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nus zhig gis rnyed par gyur cig de yang g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa dar bar gyur cig bsgrags pa rin po che'i gling grags las/ dbu zhabs bar gsum tshang bar yod/ u ya smar/ 'di la shog ser kha gras/ ldeb drug la/ yig phreng nyi shu re 'dug pa la zhal bshus so/ bla ma sprul sku rma shes rab seng ges/ sham po nas bton pa'o/ de nas rim gyis brgyud nas bdag la'o//
